caption: This drawing is rendered in fine black lines on an off-white or beige background with no shading or color fills. The primary object is a long-sleeved garment, likely a shirt, depicted from the front in the center of the page. The shirt features a collar with a small buttoned band at the neck, a placket with visible buttons down the front, long sleeves with cuffs, and an extended lower hem with side gussets. There is stitching indicated along the seams and edges. To the upper right of the central shirt is a smaller back view of the same garment, showing a yoke, gathered fabric at the top, and a central back placket. Above this back view is a small rectangle containing a faint sketch of a scene with several human figures. The background is plain, and no additional objects or decorative elements are present.
title: Shirt
